$comment: Exceptions for scripts/check-ipc.mjs. Every entry needs a reason. Sections: commands (invoked names that are not registered), events (listened names with no emitter), dynamic ({file, expr, kind?} for invoke/listen targets that cannot be resolved statically). Remove an entry as soon as its cause is gone: stale dynamic entries and allowlisted commands that became registered fail the check.
